purpose: Raw current working state, raw reference data, worker-return provenance archive, deterministic retrieval/indexing/ingest/transport programs, and successor-thread rehydration support.

directories.state: Normalized current master/reference state and active-cycle control data
directories.reference_raw: Materialized Rev3/RevW3 reference data and Rev3 V00-V18 volumes
directories.working_raw: Materialized worker return packets and normalized package-name copies
directories.programs: Codec, index, retrieval, rehydration, verification and bootstrap programs
directories.transport: Generated MRE2 transport envelopes for successor threads

large_reference_policy.default_index: metadata + state + worker returns + compact reference CSV/JSON
large_reference_policy.reason: Avoid requiring full 143MB site-work history and other large datasets in RAM or conversational context.

known_reference_gap: Rev3 DATA07 SQLite was historically referenced but is not present as a raw source file; the bundle includes a newly generated local SQLite retrieval index and preserves this distinction in state/known_raw_gaps.json.

programs.ofg_index.py: Build local SQLite/FTS catalog; --include-large and --docs enable deep indexing
programs.ofg_retrieve.py: Bounded indexed retrieval plus streaming raw scan
programs.ofg_transport.py: Generate ordered MRE2 activation transport shards
programs.ofg_ingest.py: Idempotent raw worker-return ingestion with duplicate/hash quarantine; no semantic merge
programs.ofg_verify.py: Verify bundle file hashes against manifest
programs.bootstrap.sh: Rebuild default index and successor capsules
